run_glue_finetuning: run a GLUE benchmark text classification fine-tuning script on Habana Gaudi accelerators using GaudiTrainer
finetune_sequence_classification_habana: finetune a pretrained sequence classification model on GLUE tasks with mixed precision on Gaudi hardware
train_text_classifier_glue: train a text classifier on any GLUE task like SST-2, MNLI, or QNLI using Hugging Face transformers
evaluate_text_classification_model: evaluate a fine-tuned text classification model on GLUE validation sets and compute accuracy or regression metrics
predict_text_classification: run predictions on a test dataset and save classification results to a text file
